description: This test file contains unit tests for the analytics API endpoints in a Flask backend application. It verifies authorization, service call forwarding with correct parameters, and default behaviors for the analytics routes.

methods.name: test_pareto_requires_auth(client)
methods.description: Tests that the /api/analytics/pareto endpoint requires authentication and returns 401 Unauthorized when auth headers are missing.

methods.name: test_pareto_success_forwards_query(client, auth_headers)
methods.description: Tests that the /api/analytics/pareto endpoint forwards the query parameters correctly to the AnalyticsService and returns expected JSON with total count.

methods.name: test_trends_defaults_interval_to_day(client, auth_headers)
methods.description: Tests that the /api/analytics/trends endpoint defaults the interval parameter to 'day' and forwards the call correctly.
